definition: One row per patient encounter. Covers office, procedure, imaging, surgery, telehealth.
notes: Date range 2022-2024. Demo dataset contains 5,000 sampled rows.

definition: One row per referral order. A single encounter may generate multiple referrals.
notes: is_external=1 indicates leakage. Referrals to affiliated independently owned practices may be inconsistently coded.

definition: One row per scheduled appointment. Not every appointment becomes an encounter and not every encounter had a prior appointment.
notes: fact_appointment and fact_encounter are not joinable at row level by design.

definition: Pre-aggregated monthly rollup of claim financials by payer and location.
notes: Monthly grain only. Cannot answer daily or weekly financial questions.

definition: Pre-aggregated monthly rollup of claim denials by payer, location, and denial reason.
notes: Monthly grain only.

definition: Month-end accounts receivable snapshot by payer and location with aging buckets.
notes: Snapshot table -- each row represents AR state at month end, not a transaction.

definition: Date the clinical service was rendered.
notes: Full date available -- day of week, month, year queries all supported.

definition: Links encounter to dim_patient. New patient = service_date within 30 days of first_visit_date.
notes: Join to dim_patient to get demographics and first visit date.

definition: Work Relative Value Units. Measures clinical work and complexity. Primary productivity metric.
notes: Does not reflect reimbursement. Always normalize by FTE when comparing providers. Do not compare raw wRVU across specialties without context.

definition: Gross charge billed before adjustments or denials.
notes: Not a revenue metric. Use fact_claim_month.paid_amount_total for actual collected revenue.

definition: Category of service: Office, Procedure, Imaging, Surgery, Telehealth.
notes: Surgery and Procedure have significantly higher wRVU and charges. Filter carefully when comparing across types.

definition: 1 = referral left the network (leakage). 0 = kept internal.
notes: Leakage rate = SUM(is_external) / COUNT(referral_id). revenue_at_risk only populated when is_external=1.

definition: 1 = destination is contracted in-network. 0 = out of network.
notes: External referral can still be in-network. Leakage and network compliance are related but not identical metrics.

definition: Estimated revenue lost from referral leaving the network.
notes: Only populated when is_external=1. Directional estimate based on average allowed amount for specialty. Not a precise financial projection.

definition: Clinical specialty the patient was referred to.
notes: Primary field for leakage analysis by specialty.

definition: Sourced from dim_referral_destination. 1 = destination is a direct competitor.
notes: Competitor referrals are highest priority leakage. Non-competitor referrals may be clinically appropriate and not recoverable.

definition: Current status: Completed, Pending, Cancelled, No Show.
notes: Focus leakage analysis on Completed referrals. Pending referrals represent future revenue at risk.

definition: Days between booking date and appointment date. Primary access metric.
notes: Benchmarks: primary care under 7 days, Rheumatology/Dermatology 30-40 days, Oncology under 7 days.

definition: 1 = patient did not attend and did not cancel in advance.
notes: No-show rate = SUM(no_show_flag) / COUNT(appointment_id). Benchmark 5-8%. Above 10% indicates systemic issue.

definition: 1 = appointment cancelled in advance by patient or practice.
notes: Mutually exclusive with no_show_flag. High cancellation with long scheduled_days_out suggests patients book too far out.

definition: 1 = appointment within 30 days of patient first_visit_date. Approximates new patient visit.
notes: Derived approximation. Transferred patients appear as new. True new-to-practice identification requires Epic registration data.

definition: Category: New Patient, Follow-Up, Procedure, Telehealth, Annual Wellness.
notes: Track new patient volume separately from follow-up to assess practice growth.

definition: Total cash collected after contractual adjustments, denials, and patient collections. This is net revenue.
notes: Correct field for revenue analysis. Do not use charge_amount as a revenue metric.

definition: Amount payer contractually agrees to pay before denials and patient responsibility.
notes: Compare to paid_amount_total to assess collection efficiency.

definition: Allowed amount minus denied portion.
notes: Gap between this and paid_amount_total represents uncollected patient responsibility and write-offs.

definition: Count of claims denied by payer in the month.
notes: Denial rate = denied_claims / claims. Benchmark under 5%. Medicaid typically 7-10%.

definition: Dollar value of denied claims.
notes: Focus denial recovery on high-dollar reasons first.

definition: Weighted average days claims outstanding at month end.
notes: Benchmark 30-45 days specialty practices. Above 50 days indicates collection issues.

definition: AR outstanding more than 90 days at month end.
notes: Best practice under 15% of total AR. Medicaid and Self Pay typically dominate this bucket.

definition: Date of patient earliest encounter. Used to identify new patients.
notes: Patients first seen before 2022 will not appear as new patients in this dataset.

definition: Full Time Equivalent. 1.0 = full time. Used to normalize productivity.
notes: Always normalize wRVU by FTE when comparing providers.

definition: High-level classification: Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Government, Self Pay, Other.
notes: Self Pay and Charity have significantly lower collection rates than Commercial or Medicare.

definition: 1 = destination is a direct competitor. 0 = non-competitive.
notes: Prioritize competitor leakage recovery. Non-competitor referrals may be clinically necessary.

definition: Geographic region: Central, West, East, South, North.
notes: Central=inner Portland. West=Beaverton/Hillsboro. East=Gresham/Happy Valley. South=Tualatin/Lake Oswego. North=Vancouver WA.
